{{Quote|I'm leading the disaster response at this crash site, and what's happening is absolutely astounding!|Pordav|<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" />}}
'''Pordav''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked for [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]],<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> a subsidiary division of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] founded to protect valuable resources of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Galactic Sustainability Institute}}</ref> Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> Pordav led the disaster response at the [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]] of [[Jannimak]], a [[research vessel]] that carried flora and fauna from all over the galaxy, crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> The ship's systems rapidly transformed the surrounding area, endangering the ecosystem of Dantooine. Due to the dangers posed by crash site's hazardous environments, moving across it became very difficult<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> and several members of Pordav's science team were refusing to enter the site altogether, which forced Pordav to look for mercenaries.<ref name="Sporefall">{{TORcite|Sporefall|exp=lots|type=codex}}</ref> In search for outside help, he later contacted the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and explained them the details of the [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" />

Pordav and his team designated three separate zones of [[Jannimak crash site]]: [[Sporefall]],<ref name="Sporefall" /> [[Glacial Trespass]] and [[Geothermal Disruption]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> Pordav wrote a scientific paper "[[Initial observations of the Jannimak crash site on Dantooine]]", describing some of his findings.<ref name="Sporefall" /> 

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pordav first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
